question: A certain sum amounts to ₹8,571.50 in 4{{1} over 2}years at 8.5% p.a. at simple interest. The simple interest on the same sum will be ₹x in 6{{2} over 3} years at 10{ {1} over 2}% p.a. What is the value of x?
solution:
Given:

A certain sum amounts to ₹8,571.50 in 4{{1} over 2}years at 8.5% p.a. at simple interest. 

The simple interest on the same sum will be ₹x in 6{{2} over 3} years at 10{ {1} over 2}% p.a.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate of Interest

Calculation:

Let the principal amount be P

According to the concept,

P + (P × 4.5 × 8.5)/100 = 8571.5

⇒ 1.3825P = 8571.5

⇒ P = 8571.5/1.3825

⇒ P = 6200

Now, the simple interest on ₹6,200 in 6{{2} over 3} years at 10{ {1} over 2}% p.a.

⇒ (6200 × 20/3 × 21/2) ÷ 100

⇒ ₹4,340

**∴ The value of x is ₹4,340.**
